cohort: 11328 pregnant women giving birth between June 2009 and May 2012
finding: Maternal age ≥40 years was associated with poorer obstetric and perinatal outcomes, including increased risks of cesarean section, intrauterine growth retardation, and fetal macrosomia.
mod_finding: Women aged 40 years or older had a significantly higher rate of cesarean sections compared to younger age groups.
